title: An initial unused factor gives an extra degeneracy of the split coproduct bar
statement:
Let $O$ be a small set, let $F,A,V$ be small ordinary categories [def-nagata-category] with object set $O$, and let $v:A\to V$ be a functor equal to the identity on $O$. All functors below fix $O$. Write $D*E$ for the coproduct of $D,E$ in categories with object set $O$: arrows are composable words of arrows of the factors modulo the composition and identity relations within each factor. Let $A_i$ denote labelled copies of $A$. Define an augmented simplicial category by
$$R_n=F*A_0*\cdots*A_n*V\quad(n\geq0),\qquad R_{-1}=F*V.$$
For $n\geq1$, the face $d_i:R_n\to R_{n-1}$, $0\leq i<n$, folds $A_i,A_{i+1}$ by the identity of $A$ and reindexes later copies; $d_n$ sends $A_n$ into $V$ by $v$. The degeneracy $s_i:R_n\to R_{n+1}$ inserts an unused copy of $A$ immediately after $A_i$, sending an old copy $k$ to copy $k$ if $k\leq i$ and to copy $k+1$ otherwise. All these maps fix $F,V$. The augmentation $\varepsilon_n:R_n\to F*V$ fixes $F,V$ and sends every $A_i$ into $V$ by $v$. Simplicial and augmented simplicial objects have the functor and operator conventions of [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set]. Let $h_{-1}:F*V\to R_0$ be the coproduct inclusions, and let $h_n:R_n\to R_{n+1}$ insert an unused copy before $A_0$, send each old copy $A_k$ identically to copy $A_{k+1}$, and fix $F,V$. These functors satisfy
$$\varepsilon_0h_{-1}=1_{F*V},\quad d_0h_n=1_{R_n},\quad d_1h_0=h_{-1}\varepsilon_0,$$
$$d_{i+1}h_{n+1}=h_nd_i\quad(0\leq i\leq n+1),\qquad s_{i+1}h_n=h_{n+1}s_i\quad(0\leq i\leq n).$$
Consequently, for every $x,y\in O$, restricting these functors to the mapping sets gives an extra degeneracy in exactly the sense of [lem-coef-extra-degeneracy-contraction] for the augmentation of simplicial sets $R_\bullet(x,y)\to\operatorname{const}((F*V)(x,y))$. No freeness hypothesis on $F,A,V$ is imposed.
